item.title: Whiskers 0.8.55
item.description:
What's New in 0.8.55

### Reliability & Diagnostics

  • Improved startup reliability by making recording and hotkey issues easier for Whiskers to detect and recover from
  • Added clearer internal diagnostics around recording readiness, local model status, and hotkey startup so setup-related problems are easier to catch before they interrupt dictation

    • ### General Settings

  • Added installed version and build details to General Settings so it is easier to confirm exactly which Whiskers build you are running
